# miniz inflate

https://github.com/richgel999/miniz
Pinned commit: 2c50092b3a4010760df02e7842960abdc3f25ee3
MIT license: LICENSE.

Only the raw DEFLATE decompressor is included, for optional DocumentIO ZIP imports.
miniz_tinfl.cpp is upstream miniz_tinfl.c named for C++ builds, with its umbrella include replaced by miniz_tinfl.h.
miniz_export.h supplies the empty export macro used by this static build.

Trailing whitespace and final blank lines are normalized for the repository.
